reason: Encore buys defaulted consumer receivables from banks and creditors and earns money by collecting on them, plus servicing fees. Upbound is a lease-to-own retailer. It leases furniture, appliances and electronics through its own stores and partner retailers, and it runs a consumer fintech app. The two share only a broad link: both deal with credit-stressed consumers. The products, the B2B counterparties and the revenue models differ.
